messages:
Erin: quick check — onboarding halcyon11b for catalog. where are the final weights + manifest? planning a batch-size sweep today, want to validate tokenizer oddities first.
Sam: uploaded to s3://redwood-models/halcyon11b/v1/weights.tar.zst and s3://redwood-models/halcyon11b/v1/manifest.json. md5sums in the manifest.
Erin: thx — can you paste the model config we should use for the serving container? specifically kv-cache + max_seq settings.
Sam: config snippet: ```
model: halcyon11b
max_seq_len: 2048
kv_cache: enabled
dtype: q4_0
pad_token: <pad>
bos_token: <s>
```
Sam: note: tokenizer has a nonstandard BOS (<s>) and merges include an empty-prefix entry that blew up an earlier tokenization test. see comment in manifest: "merge-index-0-empty".
Jia: thanks — i'll run a quick tokenizer audit (merge edge-case, unk handling) before perf. can you confirm sample prompts/seqlen distribution to use for the sweep?
Erin: primary traffic: short completions (seq_out 50, prompt 40) ~60%, medium summaries (seq_out 200, prompt 600) ~30%, long form (seq_out 512, prompt 1500) ~10%. use these proportions.
Jia: got it. i'll schedule runs on bench-cluster-2 tonight. target batch sizes [1,4,8,16] and sequences [128,512,1024,2048] mix per distribution.
Alex: FYI autoscaler needs a reserve flag for these runs, otherwise the cluster may reclaim GPUs mid-sweep. set reserve=true in the bench job.
Erin: can bench include kv cache hit/miss metrics + per-token latency p95/p99? also want mem usage and swap to catch OOMs.
Jia: yes — bench job will collect: per-token p50/p95/p99, gpu_mem_peak, cpu_mem_rss, kv_cache_hit_rate, batch_latency_histogram.
Sam: small heads-up: q4_0 path has an extra matmul kernel fallback on A100-40GB that adds ~0.8ms/token in our smoke tests. expect a bump on those nodes.
Erin: ok include node-type annotation in results. if A100-40 shows big regressions, fallback to A100-80 nodes for the canary.
bench-bot: RUN_SCHEDULED: halcyon11b-batch-sweep started on bench-cluster-2 at 1764550200. job_id=b-7731.
Jia: will post interim summary when first 2 batch sizes finish.
Erin: also ping @sam for checksum and @alex if autoscaler needs manual toggle.
Sam: checksum OK, manifest verified.
Alex: autoscaler reserve set for job b-7731, retention 2h. :white_check_mark:
bench-bot: RUN_COMPLETE: halcyon11b batch=1, seq=128, p95=12.3ms, p99=18.9ms, kv_hit=0.92. partial results uploaded to /bench/results/b-7731/part-001.json
Jia: initial numbers look sane. next up batch=4 seq=128.
Erin: perfect — thanks team. i'll open a tiny PR to add tokenizer note + recommended serving config in the catalog entry once you confirm final perf artefacts. :+1:
Sam: noted — will follow up if we need to patch merges.
Jia: posting final consolidated report in this thread when done.
bench-bot: RUN_COMPLETE: all scheduled jobs finished for b-7731 at 1764551700. final report /bench/results/b-7731/report.json
Erin: received. tagging for post-review: @alex, @sam, @jia. planning rollout canary tomorrow AM.
__note: This JSON represents a single Slack thread; messages are a single continuous string with sender prefixes as required by agents.md. All fields are strings or list of strings.
